schedule.help: All dates use Beijing time (UTC+8). Enabled ordinary events without a deadline start a fixed 14-day countdown when saved. Time edits preserve progress and claims.
schedule.title: Event end time
schedule.shared: Applies to the main activity and related children. Existing progress and claimed rewards are preserved.
schedule.duration: Start a new countdown from now
schedule.absolute: Set an exact date and time
schedule.durationHint: Saving fixes the deadline to this many days from now. Refreshing and restarting never restart the countdown.
schedule.extendHint: Adds days to the current deadline. Expired or unset events start from now.
schedule.resetClock: Use 03:59:59 on this date (before daily reset)
schedule.unsetHint: Defaults to 14 days when enabled and saved
schedule.saved: Saved. Main and related events end at:
schedule.failed: Save failed. Refresh the page and try again.
schedule.unauthorized: Your administrator session expired. Please sign in again.
schedule.invalid: Invalid settings. Check the action and input.
schedule.invalidDays: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
schedule.invalidDate: Enter a valid future Beijing date within 3650 days.
